_doc: GPS rules (#218, user decision 2026-10-22, docs/03). Thresholds from the Tester's statewide scan (#219, posted on #218): a pile (default / dispatch) point is an exact point (5 decimals) shared by >= min_crashes crashes naming >= min_street_pairs street pairs, of which < max_fit_share fit the point; pooled across agencies. Coordinates with <= coarse_max_decimals decimals in latitude or longitude are no location. Snapped GPS: within snap_ft of the intersection the report names, while the report states more than offset_min_ft and a direction.
